_purpose: Internal work-tracking only, for the differentiator-framework-coverage scheduled task's own picker. Not read by any pipeline script and not member-facing data. A framework listed here is skipped by the routine WITHOUT re-investigation as long as neither its awarded-supplier set nor its refused-crawl list has changed since 'checkedOn'. A new award, a newly unresolved name, or a newly refused/reopened crawl on any listed supplier means the entry is stale and the framework should be re-investigated (and this entry updated or removed) rather than trusted blindly.

frameworks.framework: Ultrasound Scanners and Associated Options and Related Services
frameworks.reason: All 6 remaining suppliers checked independently today, confirming docs/framework-coverage-findings-2026-09-21-ultrasound-scanners.md unchanged: BioSpectrum/Hologic UK crawled with real catalogues containing no genuine ultrasound-scanner line; Philips/Siemens Healthineers/ProSys International Ltd crawl-refused with only unrelated NHSSC-cache stub products. Celtic SMR Ltd genuinely sells human diagnostic ultrasound (SonoScape E2/X3/E11/P25 Elite/P60/S80 Elite) but every model page is a CMS 'page-components' artefact mixed in the same sitemap section as marketing/FAQ pages — differentiator-category-map.json maps by (supplier, division) not by product name, so mapping the division would also publish 'Calendly Form' and 'Who Are We Celticsmr' as ultrasound products. This is the nav-labels-are-not-products shape (data/identity-vocabulary-policy.json) — held is correct, no ruling needed, and no route exists without a script change (a per-product override capability, or a smarter component-page filter) that is out of scope for a data batch.
frameworks.wouldReopenIf: A code change adds a per-product override route for sitemap-only captures, or a smarter component-page filter for celticsmr.co.uk; or any of the 6 suppliers gets a new/changed crawl result.
